critic.fix_suggestion: Adjust the Engine geometry's local position transform to move it inward along the X-axis and downward along the Y-axis. Specifically, decrease the offset from the wing root by 15% of the engine's total width and reduce the vertical clearance by 20% until the engine pylon geometry intersects with the wing surface mesh, ensuring a flush mount without visible gaps.

discrepancies.observed: Engines appear to be floating slightly away from the wing surface.
discrepancies.reference: Engines are flush-mounted and integrated into the wing structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move engines inward/downward to intersect with wing geometry.

discrepancies.observed: The landing gear struts do not appear to connect to the fuselage or wing roots.
discrepancies.reference: Struts are structurally joined to the main body and wing spars.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move strut endpoints to intersect with fuselage/wing surfaces.

discrepancies.observed: The vertical stabilizer appears detached from the rear fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The tail fin is seamlessly integrated into the aft fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move tail fin forward and down to merge with fuselage geometry.

discrepancies.observed: There is a visible gap between the wing base and the fuselage side.
discrepancies.reference: The wings emerge smoothly from the fuselage skin.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move wing roots inward/downward to eliminate gaps.
